projects.title: Cache Coherence Protocols
projects.description: Implemented MSI, MESI, and Dragon cache coherence protocols to simulate, test, and  evaluate the effects on performance in combination with cache configurations testcases that vary on cache size,  associativity, and block size.

projects.title: Database
projects.description: Created an Oracle database application for an Automotive Service Center using MySQL and JDBC APIs.  Accompanying Java GUI implemented via a complete MVC design pattern. Developed standard CRUD functionalities,  appointment scheduling, inventory maintenance, and invoice/payroll calculation for customers, employees and all  associated object dependencies. Designed system to enforce user and company security while ensuring high  performance through function optimization using triggers, indexing, and procedures.
